def maxSubarraySum (numbers : List Int) (h_precond : maxSubarraySum_precond (numbers)) : Int :=
  if numbers.isEmpty then 0
  else if numbers.all (· < 0) then 0
  else
    let rec findMax (acc : Int) (currentSum : Int) (remaining : List Int) : Int :=
      match remaining with
      | [] => acc
      | head :: tail =>
          let newSum := currentSum + head
          if newSum > acc then findMax newSum 0 tail else findMax acc newSum tail
    findMax 0 0 numbers
